advisory: Forthright is a planning aid. The Guide to Safe Scouting, your council and your chartered organization's rules govern. Verify before you go.

rules.title: Health form Parts A and B
rules.text: Every Scouting activity needs Parts A and B of the Annual Health and Medical Record for each person going.

rules.title: Health form Part C
rules.text: Part C, a physical exam by a licensed provider, is also needed for events longer than 72 hours, resident camps and high adventure.

rules.title: Two-deep adult leadership
rules.text: At least two registered adults aged 21 or older go on every activity, and no adult is ever alone with one Scout.

rules.title: Transport
rules.text: Drivers are 18 or older with a valid licence, no youth drive, everyone wears a seat belt, and no one drives more than 10 hours in any 24 hours.
